title: Focus themes
description: Themes you can choose to focus your training on, such as manuals or spins and turns. Each lists the skills and off-skate drills that belong to it. When someone picks a theme, sessions lean toward its skills and toward the skills that lead up to them.

id.description: Stable short id. People's chosen themes are saved by id, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

description.description: One sentence on what the theme works on.

skills.description: Skill ids from skills.json that belong to the theme, on-skate skills and the off-skate drills that support them. The skills that lead up to these are worked on too, so you don't need to list every prerequisite.
